chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام, “Should I say ‘Amin’ when I finish Fatihat al-Kitab?” He said, “No.”

key_terms.آمِينَ: the liturgical utterance ‘Amin’ said after supplication or recitation
key_terms.فَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ: the Opening of the Book, referring to Surah al-Fatihah
key_terms.لَا: no; a direct negation indicating prohibition or disallowance in this context

ai.seo_question: Should one say ‘Amin’ after reciting Fatihat al-Kitab in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that one should not say “Amin” after completing Fatihat al-Kitab. It serves as a jurisprudential ruling related to the manner of recitation in salat (prayer) according to the teaching of Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام.
